name: integrations-hero
description: Integrations hub hero: eyebrow, H1, lede and a demo button beside an art box where integration logos float in frosted glass bubbles around the Asset Panda app card (panda), over orbit rings and soft colour glows. Figma: Desktop — Integrations > Hero Section (7310:158542).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the title, e.g. INTEGRATIONS.

title.description: Title (the page H1). Line breaks are kept.

lede.description: Paragraph under the title. Line breaks are kept.

cta_label.description: Button text. The button renders only when cta_label and cta_url are both set.

panda.description: Panda image (transparent WebP) shown in the app card. Empty shows the card without a panda.

logos.description: Logo bubbles around the app card (max 20). Each: icon (image URL, SVG preferred), name (integration name, read out in the art's label), x and y (bubble centre as a % of the art box, 0-100), size (bubble diameter in design px — the art box is 546 design px wide, so sizes scale with it; 12-160), optional scale (logo size as a share of the bubble, 0.2-0.9, default 0.5; wordmarks like Workday want ~0.74). The default is the 13 Figma bubbles.

art_label.description: Accessible description of the art. Empty builds one from the logo names: "Asset Panda connects with Okta, Slack, …".
